flashcard_questions.q: How does a bubble sort decide whether to swap two items?
flashcard_questions.a: It compares neighbouring items and swaps them when they are in the wrong order.

flashcard_questions.q: Which items does a bubble sort ever compare?
What is a pass in a sorting algorithm?
flashcard_questions.a: One complete run through the list from the first item to the last.

flashcard_questions.q: Which value is guaranteed correct after each full bubble sort pass?
flashcard_questions.a: The largest remaining value, now at the end of the list.

flashcard_questions.q: When does a bubble sort know the list is in order?
flashcard_questions.a: When it completes a whole pass without making a single swap.

flashcard_questions.q: What does the list 5, 1, 4, 2 look like after the first bubble sort pass?
How does an insertion sort build its sorted section?
flashcard_questions.a: It takes each unsorted item and inserts it into the already-sorted section.

flashcard_questions.q: What happens to larger items when an insertion sort inserts a value?
flashcard_questions.a: They are shifted one place to the right to make room.

flashcard_questions.q: Which everyday task is an insertion sort compared to?
flashcard_questions.a: Sorting a hand of playing cards.

flashcard_questions.q: When is an insertion sort especially quick?
flashcard_questions.a: When the list is already nearly in order.

flashcard_questions.q: Which strategy does a merge sort use?
Why is a sub-list of one item treated as already sorted?
flashcard_questions.a: A single value cannot be out of order.

flashcard_questions.q: How are two sorted sub-lists merged together?
flashcard_questions.a: By repeatedly comparing their front items and taking the smaller one.

flashcard_questions.q: What is the drawback of a merge sort compared with a bubble sort?
flashcard_questions.a: It needs extra memory to hold the sub-lists while they are merged.

flashcard_questions.q: Which of the three sorts tends to be the slowest?

notes: 15 cards: 6 algorithm-to-property, 4 mechanism, 2 worked-example states, 3 comparison. Each sort keeps its own fronts so the three methods do not interfere. The bubble sort worked example uses the list and pass result given in the content.
